rules.title: Try-with-resources for everything closeable
rules.body: Streams, readers, connections, statements and result sets are opened in try-with-resources so they close on every path.

rules.title: No swallowed exceptions
rules.body: Do not catch an exception only to log it and continue, or leave a catch block empty. Rethrow it wrapped with context (new XException("what failed", e)) or handle it fully.

rules.title: Constructor injection only
rules.body: New Spring beans get their dependencies through the constructor (final fields), never with @Autowired on fields.

rules.title: No null returns for collections
rules.body: Methods that return collections return an empty collection instead of null. Optional is used for return values that may be absent, never for fields or parameters.

rules.title: Prepared statements and bound parameters
rules.body: SQL and JPQL take values as bound parameters; queries are never built by concatenating strings with values.

rules.title: Entities are not API responses
rules.body: Controllers return DTOs, not JPA entities, so lazy relations and internal fields never leak into responses.
